```artifact
GUI Event Graphs Test Suite for U06_Alarms

1. TC-001: Controller detects alarm from GUI
2. TC-002: Controller commands PCB buzzer
3. TC-003: GUI enumerates alarm codes and assigns priorities
4. TC-004: GUI displays highest priority alarm
5. TC-005: GUI displays list of active alarms
6. TC-006: GUI displays alarm legible at 1 meter
7. TC-007: High severity alarms indicated with red color and 2Hz flashing
8. TC-008: Low severity alarms indicated with yellow color

```json
[
  {"id": "TC-001", "title": "Controller detects alarm from GUI", "req_ids": ["RW-SW-66"], "kind": "positive",
   "preconditions": ["Controller is idle", "GUI is operational"], "inputs": {"name": "alarm signal"}, "steps": ["Receive alarm signal"], "expected": ["Controller acknowledges alarm"]},
  {"id": "TC-002", "title": "Controller commands PCB buzzer", "req_ids": ["RW-SW-67"], "kind": "positive",
   "preconditions": ["Controller is ready", "PCB buzzer is operational"], "inputs": {"name": "buzzer command"}, "steps": ["Send buzzer command"], "expected": ["PCB buzzer activates"]},
  {"id": "TC-003", "title": "GUI enumerates alarm codes and assigns priorities", "req_ids": ["RW-SW-68"], "kind": "positive",
   "preconditions": ["GUI is operational", "Controller is ready"], "inputs": {"name": "alarm code"}, "steps": ["Enter alarm code", "Assign priority"], "expected": ["Priority assigned to alarm code"]},
  {"id": "TC-004", "title": "GUI displays highest priority alarm", "req_ids": ["RW-SW-69"], "kind": "positive",
   "preconditions": ["GUI is operational", "Controller is ready"], "inputs": {"name": "priority list"}, "steps": ["Sort priority list", "Display highest priority alarm"], "expected": ["Highest priority alarm displayed"]},
  {"id": "TC-005", "title": "GUI displays list of active alarms", "req_ids": ["RW-SW-70"], "kind": "positive",
   "preconditions": ["GUI is operational", "Controller is ready"], "inputs": {"name": "active alarms list"}, "steps": ["Display active alarms list"], "expected": ["Active alarms list displayed"]},
  {"id": "TC-006", "title": "GUI displays alarm legible at 1 meter", "req_ids": ["RW-SW-71"], "kind": "positive",
   "preconditions": ["GUI is operational", "Controller is ready"], "inputs": {"name": "display settings"}, "steps": ["Set display settings", "Verify legibility at 1 meter"], "expected": ["Alarm legible at 1 meter"]},
  {"id": "TC-007", "title": "High severity alarms indicated with red color and 2Hz flashing", "req_ids": ["RW-SW-73"], "kind": "positive",
   "preconditions": ["GUI is operational", "Controller is ready"], "inputs": {"name": "severity level"}, "steps": ["Set severity level to high", "Configure flashing frequency"], "expected": ["Red color and 2Hz flashing configured"]},
  {"id": "TC-008", "title": "Low severity alarms indicated with yellow color", "req_ids": ["RW-SW-74"], "kind": "positive",
   "preconditions": ["GUI is operational", "Controller is ready"], "inputs": {"name": "severity level"}, "steps": ["Set severity level to low", "Configure constant color"], "expected": ["Yellow color configured"]}
]
